description: Multiplayer evidence ledger consumed by games/tests/site-quality.mjs. Every multiplayer game must list the E2E file that proves two independent clients joined the same room, synchronised state and produced the same result. A shipped game additionally needs cross-device, AI matchmaking, reconnect/trustee and leaderboard evidence. Missing fields are reported as draft reasons, never treated as shipped.

card-battle.notes: online-e2e.test.mjs: two independent HTTP clients join one card-battle room, read the same stateVersion/lastAction, replay an idempotent action, and see the same final winner. AI fills empty seats after the configured delay, a timed-out client is auto-played (托管), reconnect clears the trustee flag, and an AI-vs-autopilot match enters the leaderboard. Cross-device is still a loopback server plus a simulated LAN Host header and LAN Origin CORS check, not two physical devices on a real LAN; crossDevice stays false and the game stays draft.

mahjong.notes: online-e2e.test.mjs: two independent HTTP clients join one mahjong room; AI fills the remaining seats; both clients read identical stateVersion, current player and seat states. With no human input the timeout trustee plays both humans and the AI finishes the hand; both clients then read the same ended status and winner. No physical-LAN device test, no mahjong reconnect case and no mahjong leaderboard entry yet, so crossDevice/reconnect/leaderboard stay false. Draft.
